key_insight: A fully discrete space-time compatible FEM can conserve energy exactly for rotating shallow water dynamics, including a stochastic forcing extension, by using projected auxiliary variables and compatible time discretization.
engineering_relevance: This provides a high-fidelity, structure-preserving solver blueprint for geophysical flow simulations where long-time stability, conservation, and robustness matter.
method: Compatible finite elements in space combined with continuous Petrov-Galerkin schemes in time
Projected auxiliary variables enforce exact Hamiltonian energy conservation
Monolithic patch smoothers accelerate Newton solves for the space-time system
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical tests demonstrating convergence, conservation, and robustness, with solver-induced energy errors kept very small.
watch_item: Exact conservation depends on sufficiently accurate nonlinear solves, so incomplete Newton convergence may reintroduce small energy errors.
paper_title: Energy conserving compatible space--time FEM for deterministic and stochastic rotating shallow water
